findings.F1: The tested idea's effect is concentrated on heavy-volume down days. In the top fifth of the forecast, down days were followed by a next-day excess return of +1.20 % (t 5.92, 1152 cases), while up days earned −0.02 % (t −0.10, 1318 cases). Below the top fifth, the four other fifths of down days ranged only from −0.22 % to +0.47 %. This is the brief's own remark that the heavy side comes mostly from down days.
findings.F2: The short side, built from light-volume days, carries none of the book's gain.
findings.F3: On down days alone, the next-day rise is graded by volume.
findings.F4: On heavy-volume down days, the move per case is many times the cost of a trade.
findings.F5: A large fall alone is only part of the effect.
findings.F6: The heavy-down rebound appears in every 60-day trend; no single profile carries it.

ideas.idea: The heavier a coin's volume on a day that closed lower, relative to its own average daily volume over the past 20 days, the larger its rise over the next day. Light-volume days and up days are left aside.
ideas.consequence: A trader buys a coin only after a down day on unusually heavy volume, sized by how heavy, and holds no short on light volume, avoiding the short side's fees and losses.
ideas.name: heavy-volume down-day rebound

ideas.idea: The heavier a coin's volume on a day that closed lower, relative to its own average daily volume over the past 20 days, the larger its rise over the next two days.
ideas.consequence: Holding the rebound after a heavy-volume down day for two days captures about +2.2 % per case, ten times a round trip's cost, so the trades pay their fees.
ideas.name: heavy-volume fall two-day rebound

ideas.idea: The heavier a coin's volume on a day that closed lower, relative to its own average daily volume over the past 20 days, and the deeper that day's fall against its 30-day daily swing, the larger its rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: A trader takes the largest long positions after deep falls on the heaviest volume, where the forced selling being absorbed is greatest.
ideas.name: heavy-volume deep-fall rebound
